scope.goal: evaluate an automatic training-occurrence-only geographic framing layer without modifying the validated robust candidate-patch core

development_data.primary_source: the already-opened 96-pair / 480-fold robust-patch confirmation cohort, repurposed as framing development evidence only

framing_baseline.name: training_block_component_10km_padding_v1
framing_baseline.component_rule: 8-neighbour connected components of occupied global 0.1-degree blocks
framing_baseline.padding_source: already-frozen primary recovery radius; not newly tuned
framing_baseline.overlapping_padded_frames: deterministically union until no axis-aligned frame overlaps remain

comparators: fixed original taxon-region rectangle used by the robust-patch confirmation
historical infer_default_survey_scope/recommend_survey_regions operational heuristic as diagnostic only

development_endpoints.primary: intention-to-evaluate mean 10-km robust-patch lift over same-size random after complete automatic frame generation
diagnostics: held-out occurrence fraction lying inside inferred frames before candidate generation
total inferred frame area relative to the fixed original region cell
development_endpoints.failure_rule: retain every declared fold; framing or downstream failure contributes zero recovery and is not replaced

decision_rule.v1_role: diagnostic baseline only; no automatic promotion to validated product
decision_rule.next_change_if_unfavorable: change framing representation using development-only data; do not alter the frozen 2.5-percent/float32/1-km robust-patch core

exclude: all 96 robust-patch v2 taxa once used for framing development
